look_here_first: Find paired pale straight stipular spines and bipinnate leaves. Yellow spherical flower heads resemble huisache. A VERY NARROW elongated pod versus the thick short hard huisache pod is the strongest comparison.

best_field_traits: Paired straight pale spines at nodes
Yellow globose heads of many little flowers
Long narrow pod relative to its width

comparisons.key_distinctions: Whitened straight nodal stipular spines + mature narrow pod; do not use yellow bloom alone.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Texas native in Kew, target-zone county proof not yet documented.
